summary: The note describes "Christmas Is the Time to Say 'I Love You'", a holiday rock song by Billy Squier. It was released in 1981 as the B-side of his hit "My Kinda Lover" on Capitol Records. A 1981 video of the song features MTV VJs and staff singing along with a live Squier performance, which VJ Martha Quinn recalls as her number one moment at MTV.
one_line: A 1981 holiday rock song by Billy Squier, released as the B-side of "My Kinda Lover", with an MTV sing-along video.
key_facts: "Christmas Is the Time to Say 'I Love You'" is a holiday rock song by Billy Squier.
It was released as the B-side of Billy Squier's hit "My Kinda Lover".
"My Kinda Lover" was released on Capitol 5037.
In 1981, a video of "Christmas Is the Time to Say 'I Love You'" was recorded.
The video featured MTV VJs and staff members singing along with a live performance by Billy Squier.
VJ Martha Quinn remembers the video as her number one moment when working for MTV.
